# Prompts FLUX 3 en español (`es-ES`)

Tres traducciones de escenas comunes, mantenidas por el equipo de bestimage.ai. Esta selección no es una traducción completa de los 84 prompts de la biblioteca. Son propuestas creativas. Los identificadores, los tiempos, los objetos y las restricciones se mantienen iguales en todos los idiomas.

[Presentación del proyecto en inglés](../README.md) · [Índice de idiomas](README.md) · [Fuentes y atribución](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — Una frase útil

[Escena original en inglés: X01](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

**Uso:** vídeo breve para redes sociales con humor impasible · **Modo:** de texto a vídeo  
**Formato:** 9:16, 15 segundos · **Se puede adaptar:** la ropa, pero no la pausa ni el diálogo.

```text
Una persona adulta que modera una reunión está sentada a una mesa de reuniones sencilla y lleva un jersey gris. Un pequeño micrófono de sobremesa y un cuaderno cerrado son los únicos objetos. Plano medio fijo con cámara de móvil; iluminación de oficina corriente.
00:00–00:05 — La persona enciende el micrófono con el botón que ya tiene, mira hacia la cámara y dice con calma en español, exactamente: «Tenemos tiempo para una frase útil».
00:05–00:10 — Mantener cinco segundos completos de silencio sincero. La persona mira una sola vez el cuaderno cerrado, pero no lo abre.
00:10–00:15 — Volver a levantar la mirada y decir exactamente: «Era esa». Apagar el micrófono y permanecer en el asiento.
SONIDO: Ventilación suave, dos pequeños clics de botón y voz natural. Sin música, risas ni reacción del público.
TEXTO: Ninguno; sin subtítulos automáticos.
MANTENER: Una persona, un micrófono, un cuaderno; el mismo rostro, las mismas manos y ropa, y el mismo encuadre.
EVITAR: diálogo adicional, actuación exagerada, abrir el cuaderno, nuevos asistentes, identidad corporativa ficticia o marca de agua.
```

## I18N-02 — Dos separadores, un sitio

[Escena original en inglés: E01](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

**Uso:** concepto de montaje de un organizador sin herramientas · **Modo:** de texto a vídeo  
**Formato:** 16:9, 20 segundos · **Se puede adaptar:** el tono de la madera, pero no el número de piezas.

```text
Mostrar un pequeño organizador de escritorio de madera sobre un banco de trabajo sencillo. El producto consta de exactamente tres piezas: una base rectangular con dos ranuras paralelas y dos separadores verticales idénticos. Las manos de una persona adulta no llevan joyas. Cámara cenital fija, luz diurna suave desde la izquierda.
00:00–00:05 — Mostrar las tres piezas por separado. La mano derecha coge un separador; la izquierda sujeta la base.
00:05–00:11 — Deslizar ese separador por la primera ranura hasta que quede encajado a ras. Insertar el segundo separador en la segunda ranura. Sin cortes ocultos ni fijaciones adicionales.
00:11–00:16 — Colocar un cuaderno azul cerrado en posición vertical entre los separadores. El cuaderno es un objeto de atrezo, no una pieza adicional del organizador.
00:16–00:20 — Retirar ambas manos y mantener el plano de la disposición terminada. El cuaderno permanece sujeto sin cambiar de tamaño.
SONIDO: Dos contactos suaves entre piezas de madera, papel sobre madera y ambiente tranquilo de la sala. Sin diálogo ni música.
TEXTO: Ninguno.
MANTENER: Las mismas tres piezas, las dos ranuras, la veta de la madera y el cuaderno durante toda la secuencia.
EVITAR: automontaje, separadores adicionales, dedos que desaparecen, tornillos nuevos, afirmaciones inventadas sobre la carga que soporta, texto, logotipos o marca de agua.
```

## I18N-03 — Mover la tarjeta, no la luz

[Escena original en inglés: L01](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

**Uso:** demostración introductoria sobre las sombras · **Modo:** de texto a vídeo  
**Formato:** 16:9, 15 segundos · **Se puede adaptar:** la forma de la tarjeta, manteniendo fijas la luz y la pantalla.

```text
Crear una demostración sencilla en el aula. Una pequeña lámpara a la izquierda ilumina una pantalla blanca vertical a la derecha. Entre ambas hay una única tarjeta cuadrada opaca sobre un mango corto. Una cámara lateral fija muestra a la vez la lámpara, la tarjeta y la sombra.
00:00–00:05 — Mantener la disposición inicial. Una mano adulta sujeta el mango de la tarjeta sin tapar la lámpara.
00:05–00:10 — Acercar lentamente la tarjeta a la lámpara, siguiendo la línea entre la lámpara y la pantalla. Su sombra en la pantalla aumenta de tamaño. La lámpara y la pantalla no se mueven.
00:10–00:15 — Detener el movimiento y mantener la nueva disposición. La mano mantiene la tarjeta inmóvil.
NARRACIÓN: Decir en español con claridad, exactamente: «La luz permanece aquí. Acercar la tarjeta a la luz hace que su sombra sea más grande».
SONIDO: Ambiente tranquilo del aula por debajo de la narración; sin música.
TEXTO: Ninguno.
MANTENER: Una lámpara, una tarjeta, una pantalla, brillo constante y una sola sombra coherente.
EVITAR: sombra que se reduce durante el movimiento, varias fuentes de luz, tarjeta flotante, pantalla cambiante, rótulos adicionales, logotipos o marca de agua.
```

# Prompts FLUX 3 en français (`fr-FR`)

Trois traductions de scènes communes, maintenues par l'équipe bestimage.ai. Cette sélection ne constitue pas une traduction intégrale des 84 prompts de la bibliothèque. Ces scènes sont des propositions créatives. Les identifiants, les durées, les objets et les contraintes restent identiques d'une langue à l'autre.

[Présentation du projet en anglais](../README.md) · [Index des langues](README.md) · [Sources et attribution](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — Une phrase utile

[Scène source en anglais : X01](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

**Usage :** courte vidéo humoristique pour les réseaux sociaux, sur un ton impassible · **Mode :** texte vers vidéo  
**Format :** 9:16, 15 secondes · **À adapter :** les vêtements, pas la pause ni le dialogue.

```text
Une personne adulte animant une réunion, vêtue d'un pull gris, est assise à une table de réunion simple. Un petit microphone de table et un carnet fermé sont les seuls objets présents. Plan moyen fixe, filmé avec un téléphone ; éclairage de bureau ordinaire.
00:00–00:05 — La personne allume le microphone avec son bouton existant, regarde vers la caméra et dit calmement en français, exactement : « Nous avons le temps pour une phrase utile. »
00:05–00:10 — Maintenir cinq secondes entières de silence sincère. La personne jette un seul regard au carnet fermé, sans l'ouvrir.
00:10–00:15 — Relever les yeux et dire exactement : « C'était celle-là. » Éteindre le microphone et rester en position assise.
SON : Ventilation discrète, deux petits clics de bouton et voix naturelle. Ni musique, ni rires, ni réaction du public.
TEXTE : Aucun ; pas de sous-titres automatiques.
À CONSERVER : Une personne, un microphone, un carnet ; le même visage, les mêmes mains et vêtements, et le même cadrage.
À ÉVITER : dialogue supplémentaire, jeu exagéré, ouverture du carnet, nouveaux participants, fausse identité visuelle d'entreprise ou filigrane.
```

## I18N-02 — Deux séparateurs, une place

[Scène source en anglais : E01](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

**Usage :** concept d'assemblage sans outil d'un rangement de bureau · **Mode :** texte vers vidéo  
**Format :** 16:9, 20 secondes · **À adapter :** la teinte du bois, pas le nombre de pièces.

```text
Montrer un petit rangement de bureau en bois sur un établi simple. Le produit comporte exactement trois pièces : une base rectangulaire avec deux rainures parallèles et deux séparateurs verticaux identiques. Les mains d'une personne adulte ne portent aucun bijou. Caméra fixe en vue du dessus, lumière du jour douce venant de la gauche.
00:00–00:05 — Montrer les trois pièces séparées. La main droite prend un séparateur ; la gauche stabilise la base.
00:05–00:11 — Faire glisser ce séparateur dans la première rainure jusqu'à ce qu'il soit bien en place, à fleur. Insérer le second séparateur dans la seconde rainure. Aucun raccord dissimulé ni fixation supplémentaire.
00:11–00:16 — Placer un carnet bleu fermé à la verticale entre les séparateurs. Le carnet est un accessoire, pas une pièce supplémentaire du rangement.
00:16–00:20 — Retirer les deux mains et maintenir le plan sur l'ensemble terminé. Le carnet reste soutenu sans changer de taille.
SON : Deux légers contacts de bois, du papier contre le bois et l'ambiance calme de la pièce. Ni dialogue ni musique.
TEXTE : Aucun.
À CONSERVER : Les trois mêmes pièces, les deux rainures, le veinage du bois et le carnet pendant toute la séquence.
À ÉVITER : assemblage automatique, séparateurs supplémentaires, doigts qui disparaissent, nouvelles vis, affirmations inventées sur la charge supportée, texte, logos ou filigrane.
```

## I18N-03 — Déplacer le carton, pas la lumière

[Scène source en anglais : L01](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

**Usage :** démonstration d'initiation aux ombres · **Mode :** texte vers vidéo  
**Format :** 16:9, 15 secondes · **À adapter :** la forme du carton, en gardant la lumière et l'écran fixes.

```text
Créer une démonstration simple en classe. Une petite lampe située à gauche éclaire un écran blanc vertical situé à droite. Un seul carton carré opaque se tient entre les deux, sur une courte poignée. Une caméra fixe placée de côté montre ensemble la lampe, le carton et son ombre.
00:00–00:05 — Maintenir la disposition initiale. Une main adulte tient la poignée du carton sans masquer la lampe.
00:05–00:10 — Rapprocher lentement le carton de la lampe, en suivant l'axe entre la lampe et l'écran. Son ombre sur l'écran s'agrandit. La lampe et l'écran ne bougent pas.
00:10–00:15 — Arrêter le mouvement et maintenir la nouvelle disposition. La main garde le carton immobile.
NARRATION : Dire dans un français clair, exactement : « La lumière reste ici. Rapprocher le carton de la lumière agrandit son ombre. »
SON : Ambiance calme de la classe sous la narration ; pas de musique.
TEXTE : Aucun.
À CONSERVER : Une lampe, un carton, un écran, une luminosité constante et une seule ombre cohérente.
À ÉVITER : ombre qui rétrécit pendant le déplacement, plusieurs sources lumineuses, carton flottant, écran qui change, annotations supplémentaires, logos ou filigrane.
```

# Prompt FLUX 3 dalam Bahasa Indonesia (`id-ID`)

Terjemahan tiga adegan bersama yang dikelola oleh tim bestimage.ai. Nomor adegan, alur waktu, kamera, dan batasan kontinuitas mengikuti sumber bahasa Inggris. Ini bukan terjemahan lengkap seluruh 84 prompt dalam koleksi.

[Beranda proyek](../README.md) · [Daftar bahasa](README.md) · [Sumber dan perubahan](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — Satu kalimat yang berguna

**Kegunaan:** video pendek komedi datar untuk media sosial · **Mode:** teks ke video  
**Rasio dan durasi:** 9:16, 15 detik · **Boleh disesuaikan:** pakaian, bukan jeda atau dialog.  
**Adegan sumber:** [Satu kalimat yang berguna](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

```text
Seorang fasilitator dewasa yang mengenakan sweter abu-abu duduk di meja rapat sederhana. Hanya ada sebuah mikrofon meja kecil dan sebuah buku catatan tertutup. Kamera ponsel terkunci dalam bidikan menengah; pencahayaan kantor biasa.
00:00–00:05 — Fasilitator menyalakan mikrofon dengan tombol yang sudah ada pada mikrofon, melihat ke arah kamera, lalu berkata dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan tenang, persis: "Kita punya waktu untuk satu kalimat yang berguna."
00:05–00:10 — Pertahankan keheningan yang sungguh-sungguh selama lima detik penuh. Fasilitator melirik buku catatan yang tertutup satu kali, tetapi tidak membukanya.
00:10–00:15 — Kembali mendongak dan berkata persis: "Itulah kalimatnya." Matikan mikrofon dan tetap duduk.
AUDIO: Suara ventilasi pelan, dua klik tombol pelan, dan ucapan alami. Tanpa musik, tawa, atau reaksi penonton.
TEKS: Tidak ada; tanpa subtitel otomatis.
PERTAHANKAN: Satu orang, satu mikrofon, satu buku catatan; wajah, tangan, pakaian, dan pembingkaian yang sama.
HINDARI: dialog tambahan, akting berlebihan, membuka buku catatan, peserta baru, identitas merek perusahaan fiktif, atau tanda air.
```

## I18N-02 — Dua sekat, satu tempat

**Kegunaan:** konsep perakitan penata meja tanpa alat · **Mode:** teks ke video  
**Rasio dan durasi:** 16:9, 20 detik · **Boleh disesuaikan:** warna kayu, bukan jumlah bagian.  
**Adegan sumber:** [Dua sekat, satu tempat](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

```text
Tampilkan penata meja kayu berukuran kecil di atas meja kerja sederhana. Ada tepat tiga bagian produk: satu alas persegi panjang dengan dua alur sejajar dan dua sekat tegak yang identik. Kedua tangan seorang dewasa tidak memakai perhiasan. Kamera tetap di atas menghadap ke bawah, dengan cahaya matahari lembut dari kiri.
00:00–00:05 — Tampilkan ketiga bagian dalam keadaan terpisah. Tangan kanan mengambil satu sekat; tangan kiri menahan alas agar stabil.
00:05–00:11 — Geser sekat itu ke alur pertama sampai terpasang rapat pada tempatnya. Masukkan sekat kedua ke alur kedua. Tanpa potongan gambar tersembunyi dan tanpa pengikat tambahan.
00:11–00:16 — Letakkan satu buku catatan biru yang tertutup dalam posisi tegak di antara kedua sekat. Buku catatan adalah properti, bukan bagian tambahan dari penata meja.
00:16–00:20 — Tarik kedua tangan dan pertahankan susunan yang sudah selesai. Buku catatan tetap tertopang tanpa berubah ukuran.
AUDIO: Dua bunyi kontak kayu yang lembut, kertas menyentuh kayu, dan suasana ruangan yang tenang. Tanpa dialog atau musik.
TEKS: Tidak ada.
PERTAHANKAN: Tiga bagian, dua alur, serat kayu, dan buku catatan yang sama sepanjang adegan.
HINDARI: perakitan dengan sendirinya, sekat tambahan, jari menghilang, sekrup baru, klaim daya dukung beban yang dibuat-buat, teks, logo, atau tanda air.
```

## I18N-03 — Gerakkan kartu, bukan sumber cahaya

**Kegunaan:** demonstrasi pengantar tentang bayangan · **Mode:** teks ke video  
**Rasio dan durasi:** 16:9, 15 detik · **Boleh disesuaikan:** bentuk kartu, dengan sumber cahaya dan layar tetap pada tempatnya.  
**Adegan sumber:** [Gerakkan kartu, bukan sumber cahaya](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

```text
Buat demonstrasi kelas yang sederhana. Sebuah lampu kecil di kiri menyinari layar putih tegak di kanan. Satu kartu persegi yang tidak tembus cahaya terpasang pada pegangan pendek dan berdiri di antara keduanya. Kamera tetap dari samping memperlihatkan lampu, kartu, dan bayangan secara bersamaan.
00:00–00:05 — Pertahankan susunan awal. Satu tangan orang dewasa menggenggam pegangan kartu tanpa menghalangi cahaya lampu.
00:05–00:10 — Gerakkan kartu perlahan mendekati lampu, mengikuti garis antara lampu dan layar. Bayangannya di layar membesar. Lampu dan layar tidak bergerak.
00:10–00:15 — Berhenti dan pertahankan susunan baru. Tangan menjaga kartu tetap diam.
NARASI: Dalam bahasa Indonesia yang jelas, ucapkan persis: "Sumber cahaya tetap di sini. Menggerakkan kartu mendekati sumber cahaya membuat bayangannya lebih besar."
AUDIO: Suasana kelas yang tenang di bawah narasi; tanpa musik.
TEKS: Tidak ada.
PERTAHANKAN: Satu lampu, satu kartu, satu layar, kecerahan tetap, dan satu bayangan yang konsisten.
HINDARI: bayangan mengecil saat kartu bergerak, beberapa sumber cahaya, kartu melayang, layar berubah, label tambahan, logo, atau tanda air.
```

# Prompt FLUX 3 in italiano (`it-IT`)

Tre traduzioni di scene comuni, curate dal team di bestimage.ai. Questa selezione non è la traduzione integrale degli 84 prompt della raccolta. Le scene sono proposte creative. Identificativi, tempi, oggetti e vincoli rimangono gli stessi in tutte le lingue.

[Presentazione del progetto in inglese](../README.md) · [Indice delle lingue](README.md) · [Fonti e attribuzioni](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — Una frase utile

[Scena originale in inglese: X01](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

**Uso:** breve video per i social con umorismo impassibile · **Modalità:** da testo a video  
**Formato:** 9:16, 15 secondi · **Da adattare:** l'abbigliamento, non la pausa o il dialogo.

```text
Una persona adulta che conduce una riunione è seduta a un semplice tavolo da riunione e indossa un maglione grigio. Un piccolo microfono da tavolo e un taccuino chiuso sono gli unici oggetti. Inquadratura media fissa con la fotocamera di un telefono; normale illuminazione da ufficio.
00:00–00:05 — La persona accende il microfono usando il pulsante già presente, guarda verso la fotocamera e dice con calma in italiano, esattamente: «Abbiamo tempo per una frase utile.»
00:05–00:10 — Mantenere cinque secondi interi di silenzio sincero. La persona guarda una sola volta il taccuino chiuso, senza aprirlo.
00:10–00:15 — Rialzare lo sguardo e dire esattamente: «Era quella.» Spegnere il microfono e restare seduti.
SUONO: Ventilazione discreta, due piccoli clic del pulsante e voce naturale. Niente musica, risate o reazioni del pubblico.
TESTO: Nessuno; niente sottotitoli automatici.
MANTENERE: Una persona, un microfono, un taccuino; lo stesso volto, le stesse mani, lo stesso abbigliamento e la stessa inquadratura.
EVITARE: dialogo aggiuntivo, recitazione esagerata, apertura del taccuino, nuovi partecipanti, identità aziendale fittizia o filigrana.
```

## I18N-02 — Due divisori, un posto

[Scena originale in inglese: E01](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

**Uso:** idea di montaggio di un portaoggetti senza attrezzi · **Modalità:** da testo a video  
**Formato:** 16:9, 20 secondi · **Da adattare:** il colore del legno, non il numero di componenti.

```text
Mostrare un piccolo portaoggetti da scrivania in legno su un semplice banco da lavoro. Il prodotto è composto da esattamente tre pezzi: una base rettangolare con due scanalature parallele e due divisori verticali identici. Le mani di una persona adulta non indossano gioielli. Fotocamera fissa dall'alto, luce diurna morbida da sinistra.
00:00–00:05 — Mostrare tutti e tre i pezzi separati. La mano destra prende un divisorio; la sinistra tiene ferma la base.
00:05–00:11 — Far scorrere quel divisorio nella prima scanalatura finché non si inserisce a filo. Inserire il secondo divisorio nella seconda scanalatura. Nessuno stacco nascosto e nessun elemento di fissaggio aggiuntivo.
00:11–00:16 — Posizionare un taccuino blu chiuso in verticale tra i divisori. Il taccuino è un oggetto di scena, non un componente aggiuntivo del portaoggetti.
00:16–00:20 — Ritirare entrambe le mani e mantenere l'inquadratura sulla composizione terminata. Il taccuino rimane sostenuto senza cambiare dimensioni.
SUONO: Due lievi contatti tra pezzi di legno, carta sul legno e ambiente silenzioso della stanza. Niente dialogo o musica.
TESTO: Nessuno.
MANTENERE: Gli stessi tre pezzi, le due scanalature, la venatura del legno e il taccuino per tutta la sequenza.
EVITARE: autoassemblaggio, divisori aggiuntivi, dita che scompaiono, nuove viti, affermazioni inventate sulla capacità di carico, testo, loghi o filigrana.
```

## I18N-03 — Muovere il cartoncino, non la luce

[Scena originale in inglese: L01](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

**Uso:** dimostrazione introduttiva delle ombre · **Modalità:** da testo a video  
**Formato:** 16:9, 15 secondi · **Da adattare:** la forma del cartoncino, mantenendo fermi la luce e lo schermo.

```text
Creare una semplice dimostrazione in aula. Una piccola lampada a sinistra illumina uno schermo bianco verticale a destra. Un solo cartoncino quadrato opaco si trova tra i due, su un manico corto. Una fotocamera laterale fissa mostra insieme lampada, cartoncino e ombra.
00:00–00:05 — Mantenere la disposizione iniziale. Una mano adulta impugna il manico del cartoncino senza coprire la lampada.
00:05–00:10 — Avvicinare lentamente il cartoncino alla lampada, lungo la linea tra lampada e schermo. La sua ombra sullo schermo diventa più grande. La lampada e lo schermo non si muovono.
00:10–00:15 — Fermarsi e mantenere la nuova disposizione. La mano tiene fermo il cartoncino.
NARRAZIONE: Dire in italiano con chiarezza, esattamente: «La luce resta qui. Avvicinando il cartoncino alla luce, la sua ombra diventa più grande.»
SUONO: Ambiente tranquillo dell'aula sotto la narrazione; niente musica.
TESTO: Nessuno.
MANTENERE: Una lampada, un cartoncino, uno schermo, luminosità costante e un'unica ombra coerente.
EVITARE: ombra che si rimpicciolisce durante il movimento, più fonti di luce, cartoncino sospeso, schermo che cambia, etichette aggiuntive, loghi o filigrana.
```

# 日本語 FLUX 3 プロンプト（`ja-JP`）

bestimage.ai チームが管理する、共通の3シーンの日本語訳です。シーン番号、時間構成、カメラ、連続性の条件は英語の原文と同じです。全84件のプロンプトを翻訳したものではありません。

[プロジェクトのトップへ](../README.md) · [言語一覧](README.md) · [出典と変更内容](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — 役に立つ一言

**用途：** 淡々としたコメディーのSNS短編 · **モード：** テキストから動画  
**画面比率と長さ：** 9:16、15秒 · **調整可能：** 服装。間の長さと台詞は変更しない。  
**元のシーン：** [役に立つ一言](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

```text
灰色のセーターを着た大人の進行役が一人、簡素な会議テーブルに着いている。置かれている物は、小さな卓上マイク一本と閉じたノート一冊だけ。スマートフォンのカメラを固定したミディアムショット。照明は普通のオフィス照明。
00:00–00:05 — 進行役はマイク本体のボタンで電源を入れ、カメラを見て、落ち着いた日本語で正確にこう言う。「役に立つ一言を話す時間があります。」
00:05–00:10 — 真剣な沈黙を丸5秒間続ける。進行役は閉じたノートに一度だけ目をやるが、開かない。
00:10–00:15 — 再び顔を上げ、正確にこう言う。「今の一言でした。」マイクの電源を切り、座ったままでいる。
音声：静かな換気音、小さなボタン音が二回、自然な台詞。音楽、笑い声、観客の反応は入れない。
文字：なし。自動字幕も付けない。
固定条件：人物一人、マイク一本、ノート一冊。同じ顔、手、服装、構図を保つ。
避けるもの：追加の台詞、大げさな演技、ノートを開く動作、新たな参加者、架空の企業ブランド表示、透かし。
```

## I18N-02 — 仕切り二枚で一つの定位置

**用途：** 工具不要の卓上収納の組み立て構想 · **モード：** テキストから動画  
**画面比率と長さ：** 16:9、20秒 · **調整可能：** 木の色合い。部品数は変更しない。  
**元のシーン：** [仕切り二枚で一つの定位置](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

```text
簡素な作業台の上に、小さな木製の卓上収納を見せる。製品の部品はちょうど三つ。平行な溝が二本ある長方形の台座一つと、同じ形の直立する仕切り板二枚。大人の両手には装身具がない。真上からの固定カメラで、柔らかな日光が左から差す。
00:00–00:05 — 三つの部品を離して置いた状態で見せる。右手で仕切り板を一枚持ち上げ、左手で台座を押さえる。
00:05–00:11 — その仕切り板を一つ目の溝に沿わせて差し込み、隙間なく所定の位置に収める。二枚目の仕切り板を二つ目の溝に差し込む。つなぎ目を隠すカットや追加の留め具は使わない。
00:11–00:16 — 閉じた青いノート一冊を、仕切り板の間に立てて置く。ノートは小道具であり、収納の追加部品ではない。
00:16–00:20 — 両手を引き、完成した配置をそのまま見せる。ノートは大きさを変えず、支えられた状態を保つ。
音声：柔らかな木の接触音が二回、紙と木の接触音、静かな室内環境音。台詞や音楽は入れない。
文字：なし。
固定条件：全編を通じて同じ三つの部品、二本の溝、木目、ノートを保つ。
避けるもの：自動で組み上がる動作、余分な仕切り板、消える指、新たなねじ、根拠のない耐荷重の主張、文字、ロゴ、透かし。
```

## I18N-03 — 光源ではなくカードを動かす

**用途：** 影の仕組みの入門実演 · **モード：** テキストから動画  
**画面比率と長さ：** 16:9、15秒 · **調整可能：** カードの形。光源とスクリーンは固定する。  
**元のシーン：** [光源ではなくカードを動かす](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

```text
簡単な教室での実演を作る。左側の小さなランプが、右側に垂直に立つ白いスクリーンを照らす。不透明な正方形のカード一枚が短い持ち手に取り付けられ、その間に立っている。横からの固定カメラで、ランプ、カード、影を同時に見せる。
00:00–00:05 — 最初の配置を保つ。大人の片手がカードの持ち手を握り、ランプの光を遮らない。
00:05–00:10 — ランプとスクリーンを結ぶ直線に沿って、カードをゆっくりランプに近づける。スクリーン上の影が大きくなる。ランプとスクリーンは動かさない。
00:10–00:15 — 動きを止め、新しい配置を保つ。手はカードをしっかり静止させる。
ナレーション：明瞭な日本語で正確にこう言う。「光源はここから動かしません。カードを光源に近づけると、その影は大きくなります。」
音声：ナレーションの下に静かな教室の環境音。音楽は入れない。
文字：なし。
固定条件：ランプ一つ、カード一枚、スクリーン一枚、一定の明るさ、連続性を保った一つの影。
避けるもの：移動中に小さくなる影、複数の光源、浮くカード、変化するスクリーン、追加のラベル、ロゴ、透かし。
```

# 한국어 FLUX 3 프롬프트 (`ko-KR`)

bestimage.ai 팀이 관리하는 공통 장면 세 편의 한국어 번역입니다. 장면 번호, 시간 구성, 카메라와 연속성 조건은 영어 원문과 동일합니다. 전체 프롬프트 84편의 완역본은 아닙니다.

[프로젝트 첫 화면](../README.md) · [언어 목록](README.md) · [출처와 변경 사항](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — 유용한 말 한마디

**용도:** 무표정한 코미디 형식의 소셜 미디어용 짧은 영상 · **모드:** 텍스트로 영상 생성  
**화면 비율과 길이:** 9:16, 15초 · **조정 가능:** 의상. 침묵의 길이나 대사는 바꾸지 않는다.  
**원본 장면:** [유용한 말 한마디](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

```text
회색 스웨터를 입은 성인 진행자 한 명이 평범한 회의용 테이블에 앉아 있다. 물건은 작은 탁상용 마이크 한 개와 닫힌 노트 한 권뿐이다. 휴대폰 카메라를 고정한 미디엄 샷으로, 일반적인 사무실 조명을 사용한다.
00:00–00:05 — 진행자는 마이크에 달린 기존 버튼으로 전원을 켜고 카메라를 바라보며 차분한 한국어로 정확히 말한다. "유용한 말 한마디를 할 시간이 있습니다."
00:05–00:10 — 진지한 침묵을 꼬박 5초 동안 유지한다. 진행자는 닫힌 노트를 한 번 흘끗 보지만 펼치지 않는다.
00:10–00:15 — 다시 고개를 들고 정확히 말한다. "방금 그 말이었습니다." 마이크를 끄고 계속 앉아 있는다.
오디오: 조용한 환기 소리, 작은 버튼 소리 두 번, 자연스러운 대사. 음악, 웃음소리, 관객 반응은 넣지 않는다.
문자: 없음. 자동 자막도 넣지 않는다.
고정 조건: 사람 한 명, 마이크 한 개, 노트 한 권. 얼굴, 손, 의상, 구도를 동일하게 유지한다.
피할 것: 추가 대사, 과장된 연기, 노트를 펼치는 행동, 새 참석자, 가상의 기업 브랜드 표시, 워터마크.
```

## I18N-02 — 칸막이 두 개로 만드는 한 자리

**용도:** 도구 없이 조립하는 책상 정리대 구상 · **모드:** 텍스트로 영상 생성  
**화면 비율과 길이:** 16:9, 20초 · **조정 가능:** 나무 색조. 부품 수는 바꾸지 않는다.  
**원본 장면:** [칸막이 두 개로 만드는 한 자리](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

```text
평범한 작업대 위에 작은 목재 책상 정리대를 보여 준다. 제품 부품은 정확히 세 개다. 평행한 홈 두 개가 있는 직사각형 받침대 한 개와 모양이 같은 수직 칸막이 두 개다. 성인의 양손에는 장신구가 없다. 카메라는 위에서 내려다보는 위치에 고정하고, 왼쪽에서 부드러운 햇빛이 들어온다.
00:00–00:05 — 세 부품을 모두 분리해 놓은 상태로 보여 준다. 오른손은 칸막이 하나를 집고 왼손은 받침대를 잡아 고정한다.
00:05–00:11 — 집어 든 칸막이를 첫 번째 홈에 밀어 넣어 틈없이 제자리에 맞춘다. 두 번째 칸막이를 두 번째 홈에 끼운다. 편집으로 연결 부분을 숨기지 말고 추가 고정 부품도 사용하지 않는다.
00:11–00:16 — 닫힌 파란색 노트 한 권을 두 칸막이 사이에 세워 놓는다. 노트는 소품이지 정리대의 추가 부품이 아니다.
00:16–00:20 — 양손을 빼고 완성된 배치를 유지한다. 노트는 크기가 바뀌지 않은 채 계속 지지된다.
오디오: 부드러운 나무 접촉 소리 두 번, 종이와 나무의 접촉 소리, 조용한 실내 환경음. 대사나 음악은 넣지 않는다.
문자: 없음.
고정 조건: 전체 장면에서 동일한 부품 세 개, 홈 두 개, 나뭇결과 노트를 유지한다.
피할 것: 저절로 조립되는 모습, 추가 칸막이, 사라지는 손가락, 새 나사, 근거 없는 하중 성능 주장, 문자, 로고, 워터마크.
```

## I18N-03 — 광원 대신 카드를 움직이기

**용도:** 그림자 원리 입문 시연 · **모드:** 텍스트로 영상 생성  
**화면 비율과 길이:** 16:9, 15초 · **조정 가능:** 카드 모양. 광원과 스크린은 고정한다.  
**원본 장면:** [광원 대신 카드를 움직이기](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

```text
간단한 교실 시연을 만든다. 왼쪽의 작은 램프가 오른쪽에 수직으로 세운 흰색 스크린을 비춘다. 짧은 손잡이에 달린 불투명한 정사각형 카드 한 장이 그 사이에 서 있다. 측면에 고정한 카메라로 램프, 카드, 그림자를 함께 보여 준다.
00:00–00:05 — 초기 배치를 유지한다. 성인의 한 손이 램프 빛을 가리지 않으면서 카드 손잡이를 잡는다.
00:05–00:10 — 램프와 스크린을 잇는 직선을 따라 카드를 램프 쪽으로 천천히 가까이 옮긴다. 스크린에 생긴 그림자가 커진다. 램프와 스크린은 움직이지 않는다.
00:10–00:15 — 움직임을 멈추고 바뀐 배치를 유지한다. 손은 카드를 흔들림 없이 잡고 있는다.
내레이션: 또렷한 한국어로 정확히 말한다. "광원은 여기 그대로 있습니다. 카드를 광원에 가까이 옮기면 그림자가 더 커집니다."
오디오: 내레이션 아래로 조용한 교실 환경음이 들린다. 음악은 넣지 않는다.
문자: 없음.
고정 조건: 램프 한 개, 카드 한 장, 스크린 한 개, 일정한 밝기, 연속성을 유지하는 그림자 하나.
피할 것: 이동 중에 작아지는 그림자, 여러 광원, 떠 있는 카드, 바뀌는 스크린, 추가 표시 문구, 로고, 워터마크.
```

# Prompts FLUX 3 em português do Brasil (`pt-BR`)

Traduções de três cenas compartilhadas, mantidas pela equipe bestimage.ai. Esta seleção não é a tradução completa dos 84 prompts da biblioteca. As cenas são propostas criativas. Os identificadores, tempos, movimentos de câmera e restrições de continuidade correspondem aos textos finais em inglês.

[Página principal](../README.md) · [Índice de idiomas](README.md) · [Fontes e atribuição](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — Uma frase útil

**Uso:** vídeo curto de humor impassível para redes sociais · **Modo:** texto para vídeo  
**Formato:** 9:16, 15 segundos · **Ajuste:** roupas, sem alterar a pausa nem o diálogo.  
**Original em inglês:** [X01](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01).

```text
Uma pessoa adulta que conduz a reunião, vestindo um suéter cinza, está sentada a uma mesa de reunião simples. Um pequeno microfone de mesa e um caderno fechado são os únicos objetos. Plano médio fixo com câmera de celular; iluminação comum de escritório.
00:00–00:05 — A pessoa liga o microfone pelo botão que já existe nele, olha para a câmera e diz calmamente em português brasileiro, exatamente: "Temos tempo para uma frase útil."
00:05–00:10 — Mantenha cinco segundos completos de silêncio sincero. A pessoa olha uma vez para o caderno fechado, mas não o abre.
00:10–00:15 — A pessoa volta a levantar o olhar e diz exatamente: "Era isso." Desliga o microfone e permanece sentada.
ÁUDIO: Ventilação discreta, dois pequenos cliques de botão e fala natural. Sem música, risadas ou reação de plateia.
TEXTO: Nenhum; sem legendas automáticas.
MANTER: Uma pessoa, um microfone, um caderno; o mesmo rosto, mãos, roupas e enquadramento.
EVITAR: diálogo adicional, atuação exagerada, abrir o caderno, novos participantes, identidade visual de empresa fictícia ou marca-d'água.
```

## I18N-02 — Duas divisórias, um lugar

**Uso:** conceito de montagem de organizador sem ferramentas · **Modo:** texto para vídeo  
**Formato:** 16:9, 20 segundos · **Ajuste:** tom da madeira, sem alterar o número de peças.  
**Original em inglês:** [E01](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01).

```text
Mostre um pequeno organizador de mesa de madeira sobre uma bancada simples. Há exatamente três peças do produto: uma base retangular com duas ranhuras paralelas e duas divisórias verticais idênticas. As mãos de uma pessoa adulta não usam joias. Câmera fixa em vista superior, luz natural suave vinda da esquerda.
00:00–00:05 — Mostre as três peças separadas. A mão direita pega uma divisória; a esquerda mantém a base firme.
00:05–00:11 — Deslize essa divisória para dentro da primeira ranhura até que fique totalmente encaixada. Insira a segunda divisória na segunda ranhura. Sem corte oculto nem elementos de fixação adicionais.
00:11–00:16 — Coloque um caderno azul fechado em pé entre as divisórias. O caderno é um objeto de cena, não uma peça extra do organizador.
00:16–00:20 — Retire as duas mãos e mantenha o enquadramento da montagem pronta. O caderno continua apoiado, sem mudar de tamanho.
ÁUDIO: Dois contatos suaves de madeira, papel sobre madeira e som ambiente discreto. Sem diálogo ou música.
TEXTO: Nenhum.
MANTER: As mesmas três peças, duas ranhuras, veios da madeira e caderno durante toda a cena.
EVITAR: automontagem, divisórias extras, dedos desaparecendo, parafusos novos, alegações inventadas de capacidade de carga, texto, logotipos ou marca-d'água.
```

## I18N-03 — Mova o cartão, não a luz

**Uso:** demonstração introdutória sobre sombras · **Modo:** texto para vídeo  
**Formato:** 16:9, 15 segundos · **Ajuste:** formato do cartão, mantendo a luz e a tela fixas.  
**Original em inglês:** [L01](../prompts/education-science.md#l01).

```text
Crie uma demonstração simples em sala de aula. Uma pequena lâmpada à esquerda ilumina uma tela branca vertical à direita. Um único cartão quadrado opaco fica entre elas, preso a uma haste curta. Uma câmera lateral fixa mostra a lâmpada, o cartão e a sombra juntos.
00:00–00:05 — Mantenha a disposição inicial. Uma mão adulta segura a haste do cartão sem bloquear a lâmpada.
00:05–00:10 — Mova o cartão lentamente para mais perto da lâmpada, seguindo a linha entre a lâmpada e a tela. Sua sombra na tela aumenta. A lâmpada e a tela não se movem.
00:10–00:15 — Pare e mantenha a nova disposição. A mão mantém o cartão imóvel.
NARRAÇÃO: Em português brasileiro claro, diga exatamente: "A luz fica aqui. Aproximar o cartão da luz faz a sombra dele aumentar."
ÁUDIO: Som discreto de sala de aula ao fundo da narração; sem música.
TEXTO: Nenhum.
MANTER: Uma lâmpada, um cartão, uma tela, luminosidade constante e uma única sombra coerente.
EVITAR: sombra diminuindo durante o movimento, várias fontes de luz, cartão flutuando, tela mudando, rótulos extras, logotipos ou marca-d'água.
```

# Промпты FLUX 3 на русском (`ru-RU`)

Переводы трёх общих сцен, которые поддерживает команда bestimage.ai. Это подборка, а не полный перевод всех 84 промптов библиотеки. Сцены представляют собой творческие замыслы. Идентификаторы, тайминг, движения камеры и ограничения непрерывности соответствуют окончательным английским текстам.

[Главная страница](../README.md) · [Указатель языков](README.md) · [Источники и авторство](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — Одно полезное предложение

**Применение:** короткая комедийная сцена для соцсетей с невозмутимой подачей · **Режим:** текст в видео  
**Формат:** 9:16, 15 секунд · **Можно менять:** одежду, но не паузу и не реплики.  
**Английский оригинал:** [X01](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01).

```text
Один взрослый ведущий встречи в сером джемпере сидит за простым столом для совещаний. Единственные предметы на столе — небольшой настольный микрофон и закрытый блокнот. Неподвижная камера телефона, средний план; обычное офисное освещение.
00:00–00:05 — Ведущий включает микрофон имеющейся на нём кнопкой, смотрит в сторону камеры и спокойно говорит по-русски, дословно: «У нас есть время на одно полезное предложение.»
00:05–00:10 — Выдержать полные пять секунд серьёзного молчания. Ведущий один раз смотрит на закрытый блокнот, но не открывает его.
00:10–00:15 — Снова поднять взгляд и произнести дословно: «Вот и всё.» Выключить микрофон и остаться сидеть.
ЗВУК: Тихая вентиляция, два негромких щелчка кнопки и естественная речь. Без музыки, смеха и реакции аудитории.
ТЕКСТ: Отсутствует; без автоматических субтитров.
СОХРАНИТЬ: Один человек, один микрофон, один блокнот; те же лицо, руки, одежда и кадрирование.
ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: дополнительные реплики, переигрывание, открывание блокнота, новых участников, символику вымышленной компании и водяной знак.
```

## I18N-02 — Две перегородки, одно место

**Применение:** концепция сборки органайзера без инструментов · **Режим:** текст в видео  
**Формат:** 16:9, 20 секунд · **Можно менять:** оттенок дерева, но не число деталей.  
**Английский оригинал:** [E01](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01).

```text
Показать небольшой деревянный настольный органайзер на простом верстаке. У изделия ровно три детали: одно прямоугольное основание с двумя параллельными пазами и две одинаковые вертикальные перегородки. Руки взрослого человека без украшений. Неподвижная камера сверху, мягкий дневной свет слева.
00:00–00:05 — Показать все три детали отдельно. Правая рука берёт одну перегородку, левая придерживает основание.
00:05–00:11 — Задвинуть эту перегородку в первый паз до полной посадки заподлицо. Вставить вторую перегородку во второй паз. Без скрытой монтажной склейки и дополнительных креплений.
00:11–00:16 — Поставить один закрытый синий блокнот вертикально между перегородками. Блокнот — реквизит, а не дополнительная деталь органайзера.
00:16–00:20 — Убрать обе руки и удерживать кадр с готовой композицией. Блокнот остаётся на опоре, не меняя размера.
ЗВУК: Два негромких стука деревянных деталей, звук соприкосновения бумаги с деревом и тихий фон помещения. Без диалога и музыки.
ТЕКСТ: Отсутствует.
СОХРАНИТЬ: Те же три детали, два паза, рисунок дерева и блокнот на протяжении всей сцены.
ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: самосборку, лишние перегородки, исчезающие пальцы, новые винты, выдуманные заявления о допустимой нагрузке, текст, логотипы и водяной знак.
```

## I18N-03 — Двигайте карточку, а не свет

**Применение:** вводная демонстрация образования тени · **Режим:** текст в видео  
**Формат:** 16:9, 15 секунд · **Можно менять:** форму карточки, оставляя источник света и экран неподвижными.  
**Английский оригинал:** [L01](../prompts/education-science.md#l01).

```text
Создать простую демонстрацию в классе. Небольшая лампа слева светит на вертикальный белый экран справа. Между ними стоит одна непрозрачная квадратная карточка на короткой ручке. Неподвижная боковая камера одновременно показывает лампу, карточку и тень.
00:00–00:05 — Сохранить исходное расположение. Одна рука взрослого человека держит карточку за ручку, не заслоняя лампу.
00:05–00:10 — Медленно придвинуть карточку к лампе по линии между лампой и экраном. Её тень на экране становится больше. Лампа и экран не двигаются.
00:10–00:15 — Остановить движение и сохранить новое расположение. Рука удерживает карточку неподвижно.
ДИКТОРСКИЙ ТЕКСТ: Чётко произнести по-русски, дословно: «Свет остаётся здесь. Если придвинуть карточку ближе к свету, её тень станет больше.»
ЗВУК: Тихая атмосфера класса под голосом диктора; без музыки.
ТЕКСТ: Отсутствует.
СОХРАНИТЬ: Одну лампу, одну карточку, один экран, постоянную яркость и единственную тень, соответствующую расположению предметов.
ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: уменьшение тени во время движения, несколько источников света, парящую карточку, меняющийся экран, дополнительные подписи, логотипы и водяной знак.
```

# 简体中文 FLUX 3 提示词（`zh-CN`）

由 bestimage.ai 团队维护的三个共享场景译文。场景编号、时间线、镜头与连续性约束与英文源文一致；这不是全库84条提示词的完整翻译。

[返回项目首页](../README.md) · [语言目录](README.md) · [来源与修改说明](../docs/sources.md)

## I18N-01 — 一句有用的话

**用途：** 冷面喜剧社交短片 · **模式：** 文生视频  
**画幅与时长：** 9:16，15秒 · **可调整：** 服装；不要改动停顿或对白。  
**源场景：** [一句有用的话](../prompts/social-experimental.md#x01)

```text
一名穿灰色套头衫的成年主持人坐在一张普通会议桌前。桌上只有一支小型桌面麦克风和一本合上的笔记本。固定手机镜头，中景；普通办公室照明。
00:00–00:05 — 主持人按麦克风自带的按钮将其打开，看向镜头，用平静的普通话准确说出：“我们有时间说一句有用的话。”
00:05–00:10 — 保持整整五秒认真的沉默。主持人瞥一眼合上的笔记本，但不打开。
00:10–00:15 — 再次抬头，准确说出：“就这一句。”关闭麦克风，保持坐姿。
音频：轻微的通风声、两声轻轻的按钮声和自然对白。不要音乐、笑声或观众反应声。
文字：无；不要自动字幕。
保持不变：一个人、一支麦克风、一本笔记本；相同的面容、双手、服装与构图。
避免：额外对白、夸张表演、打开笔记本、新增与会者、虚构公司品牌标识或水印。
```

## I18N-02 — 两块隔板，一个位置

**用途：** 免工具收纳架组装概念 · **模式：** 文生视频  
**画幅与时长：** 16:9，20秒 · **可调整：** 木材色调；不要改动零件数量。  
**源场景：** [两块隔板，一个位置](../prompts/ecommerce-product.md#e01)

```text
在一张普通工作台上展示一个小型木质桌面收纳架。产品零件恰好有三个：一个带两条平行插槽的长方形底座，以及两块完全相同的竖直隔板。一名成年人的双手不佩戴任何首饰。固定俯拍镜头，柔和的日光从左侧照入。
00:00–00:05 — 展示分开放置的三个零件。右手拿起一块隔板，左手扶稳底座。
00:05–00:11 — 将这块隔板滑入第一条插槽，直至完全嵌合到位。将第二块隔板插入第二条插槽。不要隐蔽剪辑，不要增加紧固件。
00:11–00:16 — 将一本合上的蓝色笔记本竖直放在两块隔板之间。笔记本是道具，不是收纳架的额外零件。
00:16–00:20 — 收回双手，保持完成后的摆放状态。笔记本继续得到支撑，尺寸不变。
音频：两声轻柔的木材接触声、纸张与木材的接触声和安静的室内环境声。不要对白或音乐。
文字：无。
保持不变：全程为相同的三个零件、两条插槽、木纹和笔记本。
避免：自行组装、额外隔板、手指消失、新增螺丝、虚构承重声明、文字、标志或水印。
```

## I18N-03 — 移动卡片，不移动光源

**用途：** 影子原理入门演示 · **模式：** 文生视频  
**画幅与时长：** 16:9，15秒 · **可调整：** 卡片形状；保持光源和屏幕固定。  
**源场景：** [移动卡片，不移动光源](../prompts/education-science.md#l01)

```text
制作一个简单的课堂演示。左侧的一盏小灯照向右侧竖直的白色屏幕。一张不透明的正方形卡片安装在短手柄上，竖立于两者之间。固定侧面镜头，同时展示灯、卡片和影子。
00:00–00:05 — 保持初始布置。一只成年人的手握住卡片的手柄，不遮挡灯光。
00:05–00:10 — 沿着灯与屏幕之间的连线，将卡片缓慢移近灯。卡片在屏幕上的影子变大。灯和屏幕保持不动。
00:10–00:15 — 停止移动，保持新的布置。手继续稳稳握住卡片。
旁白：用清晰的普通话准确说出：“光源保持在这里不动。把卡片移近光源，它的影子就会变大。”
音频：旁白下方保留安静的课堂环境声；不要音乐。
文字：无。
保持不变：一盏灯、一张卡片、一块屏幕、恒定亮度，以及始终一致的单个影子。
避免：移动过程中影子缩小、多个光源、卡片悬浮、屏幕变化、额外标签、标志或水印。
```

Fixed phone framing includes torso, hands and counter. 00:00–00:05 — Show the empty open pouch beside three items: one folded cable, one house key and one lip balm. Creator says in natural English: "These are the things I keep losing." 00:05–00:12 — Place the three items inside separately, then close the existing zipper in one uninterrupted movement. Keep the pouch's modest thickness plausible; do not shrink its contents. 00:12–00:18 — Put the closed pouch in a jacket pocket already hanging from a chair. Creator pats the pocket once and says: "Now they leave together." Hold briefly on the jacket. AUDIO: Untreated room tone, metal key, fabric and zipper. No background song or applause. LOCK: Same hands, zipper orientation, three items, pouch size and chair position. AVOID: hidden edits during packing, extra compartments, invented testimonials, price or capacity claims, subtitles, labels or watermark. ``` ## A03 — The first spoonful **Use:** tactile food advertisement **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 1:1, 15 seconds **Adjust:** bowl and topping colors; keep the food physics believable. ```text Create a close food-film concept around a shallow cream ceramic bowl containing thick tomato soup, one small basil leaf and a thin swirl of cream. A steel spoon rests on a folded linen napkin. 00:00–00:05 — Locked three-quarter macro view. An adult hand picks up the spoon by its handle. Steam rises gently, not as a dense cloud. 00:05–00:10 — The spoon enters at the near edge and draws one slow arc through the cream. The swirl breaks only where the spoon passes. Lift a small spoonful; one drop falls back into the same spot. 00:10–00:15 — The spoon exits upward. Focus returns to the ripple fading on the surface. Leave a clear, stable end frame. AUDIO: Spoon touching ceramic, a quiet pour-like movement and subtle restaurant room tone. No chewing, speech or score. AVOID: stretching soup, solid cream ribbons, endless steam, duplicate utensils, generated slogan, menu prices, logo or watermark. ``` ## A04 — One-handed opening, slowly **Use:** product interaction study for a reusable lunch box **Mode:** image to video · **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds **Input:** approved tabletop frame with the actual closed product **Adjust:** contents after verifying real compartment dimensions. ```text Use the reference as the exact first frame. One rectangular lunch box has two visible side clips and a separate silicone seal in its lid. This is a concept demonstration, not a leakproof test. 00:00–00:06 — Locked overhead shot. One hand releases the left clip; the other releases the right. Each clip remains attached to its hinge. 00:06–00:12 — Lift the lid vertically and place it beside the box, underside visible. Reveal three compartments already filled with ordinary lunch portions; do not generate steam. 00:12–00:17 — Remove one carrot stick from the front compartment. Nothing else changes position. 00:17–00:20 — Hold the open layout, leaving space for post-production annotations. AUDIO: Two distinct latch clicks, soft lid contact and room tone. AVOID: self-opening hardware, extra hinges, bending plastic, magical freshness, unsupported claims, text, brand marks or watermark. ``` ## A05 — Repair is the reveal **Use:** repair-service campaign visualization **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 9:16, 20 seconds **Adjust:** fabric and patch shape; keep the repair visibly modest. ```text Show one worn blue canvas tote on a sewing table. A small rectangular tan patch is already pinned over a tear. Only an adult repairer's hands and forearms appear. 00:00–00:06 — Medium overhead view. Fingers flatten the patch and guide a threaded needle through the first visible stitch. Keep the repair small enough for the frame. 00:06–00:14 — Cut to a close side view after an explicit time jump: most of the seam is now complete. Show the final two stitches and a tied thread. Do not imply the full repair took seconds. 00:14–00:20 — Return to overhead. The repairer removes the pins into a tray, turns the tote upright and rests a hand beside the still-visible patch. AUDIO: Needle through canvas, pin contacts and table creak. No narration or music. LOCK: Same tear location, weave, patch, stitch color and handles. The bag remains used, not restored to a new product. AVOID: unsafe needle placement, disappearing wear, invisible stitches, sustainability statistics, before-and-after proof claims, text, logos or watermark. ``` ## A06 — The quiet last seat **Use:** neighborhood venue campaign **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** venue colors; do not imply a real establishment or offer. ```text Create a fictional neighborhood café scene just before opening. A staff member in a plain brown apron places the final chair at a small window table. No customers or readable signs. 00:00–00:06 — Static medium-wide view. The staff member lifts the wooden chair clear of the floor, turns it a quarter turn and lowers all four legs beside the table. 00:06–00:12 — Move only the camera a little closer as the staff member adjusts a folded napkin and one empty glass. Morning light traces the table edge. 00:12–00:18 — Staff member steps out of frame. Hold the empty welcoming seat with space around it. No one arrives and nothing fills itself. AUDIO: Chair feet, folded cloth, distant coffee grinder from behind camera and quiet street ambience. LOCK: Four chair legs, one glass, one napkin, window position and sunlight direction. AVOID: free-food offers, reservation claims, branded interiors, extra furniture, artificial crowd noise, captions, promotional copy or watermark. ```

Handmade cadence and stylized material are creative directions, not claims about configurable output frame rates. ## N01 — The button observatory **Use:** handcrafted miniature story **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** felt colors; preserve character and mechanism count. ```text A tiny felt astronomer with a rust-colored cap operates a cardboard observatory on a worktable. The dome is made of stitched blue paper, and its simple telescope points through one opening. Original character and set. 00:00–00:06 — Locked miniature-wide shot. The astronomer turns a visible wooden crank. The dome moves in small tactile stop-motion increments around the fixed telescope. 00:06–00:12 — A loose white button rolls into the opening and comes to rest beside the telescope. The astronomer bends to inspect its four holes as if they were a star chart. 00:12–00:18 — The character carefully places the button on a little paper pedestal, then aims the telescope toward it. Hold the absurdly serious pose. LOCK: Felt seams, cap shape, four button holes, telescope size and crank connection. No real human hand enters. AUDIO: Cardboard friction, wood ticks, one button rattle and room hush. No speech or recognizable melody. AVOID: glossy plastic, smooth live-action character motion, floating gears, real night sky replacing the tabletop, existing mascots, text or watermark. ``` ## N02 — The umbrella diagram **Use:** original hand-drawn character animation **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** drawing materials, keeping the visual joke intact. ```text Use clean original 2D linework, restrained cel shading and a painted art-classroom background. Two adult design students examine a small paper umbrella on a desk. One wears round glasses and a mustard vest; the other a teal overshirt. 00:00–00:06 — Medium two-shot. The first student points to a charcoal drawing of heavy rain above a sketch of the umbrella. No readable writing. 00:06–00:12 — The second student opens the real paper umbrella under the drawing, then slowly slides the entire drawing beneath it. Keep paper stiffness and hand positions plausible. 00:12–00:18 — Both look at the now-covered storm drawing. The first student says in Japanese, exactly: "これなら、雨も休めるね。" Finish with a small smile, not a slapstick reaction. AUDIO: Paper, a delicate umbrella hinge and dry conversational Japanese. No music. LOCK: Two students, one umbrella, one drawing, same desk and light. AVOID: franchise resemblance, chibi transformation, extra dialogue, floating rain from the drawing, automatic subtitles, logos or watermark. ``` ## N03 — Folded light opener **Use:** title sequence background **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 2:1, 12 seconds **Adjust:** paper hue; add final typography in editing. ```text Create a typography-free motion-design opener using one long strip of matte ivory paper on a dark studio tabletop. The paper is the only moving object; show deliberate stylized animation, not a physics demonstration. 00:00–00:04 — Orthographic overhead camera. The strip forms two broad folds, leaving its continuous edge visible. Soft side light creates readable shadows. 00:04–00:08 — The folds open slowly to reveal a clean rectangular central space. The paper slides outward without breaking into extra pieces. 00:08–00:12 — Stop all motion and hold the empty center for an editor's title. Keep generous clear margins, no generated lettering. AUDIO: Two subtle paper creases, a soft slide and one second of silence at the end. No speech or song. LOCK: One continuous strip, consistent width, ivory material and fixed camera. AVOID: torn edges, metal reflections, confetti, spontaneous letters, camera rotation, ornamental symbols, logos or watermark. ``` ## N04 — Three words, three cards **Use:** exact-copy motion typography test **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 3:4, 15 seconds **Adjust:** card colors only; keep the quoted text unchanged for evaluation. ```text Create a flat editorial animation with three large paper cards on a warm-gray background. Camera remains orthographic. Each card carries one short word, centered in a plain readable sans serif. 00:00–00:05 — First card enters from above and stops. Its exact English text is "LISTEN". Curtain folds make one smaller return swing, responding as a single piece of fabric. 00:05–00:09 — Motion settles further until only the hem moves slightly. Do not close the window or introduce a hand. 00:09–00:12 — Hold a nearly still end frame suitable for a clean cut. AUDIO: Carry over the source ambience and cloth rustle, fading only the movement-related sound. Do not add new birds, speech or score. AVOID: resetting the oscillation, curtain multiplying, changed weather, new furniture, exposure jump, hidden dissolve, text or watermark. ``` ## F12 — Return the tool to its place **Use:** workshop continuation with object-state control **Input:** clip ending after tightening a small wooden object's final screw **Request:** source `aspect_ratio`, `duration: 15`, `sound: true` **Adjust:** ending composition within the existing workspace. ```text Start from the source clip's exact final frame. AVOID: repeated tightening, extra hardware, self-moving tool, changed grain, camera jump, safety certification, captions, logos or watermark. ``` ## Adaptation checklist 1. Choose the mode from the actual input asset, not the desired marketing label. 2. Copy the complete prompt; put model, duration, sound and media values in their own request fields. 3. Check prompt length and current API limits before submitting. Do not silently truncate a recipe. 4. A target endpoint or continuity lock is a request to the model, not a guarantee. 5. Track the returned task ID. Do not blindly resubmit a paid job after a timeout. 6. Review first/last frames, timing, language, source rights and final disclosure.

These are untested creative specifications, not model demonstrations. Use the [mode guide](../docs/prompting-guide.md) before submitting. ## C01 — The lantern relay **Use:** a small human action introducing a fictional world **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 21:9, 20 seconds **Adjust:** harbor architecture and weather; retain the signal's cause and effect. ```text Create a restrained coastal science-fiction short. A retired lighthouse keeper in an olive knitted coat stands on a stone balcony above a dark harbor, holding one rectangular amber lantern. No spacecraft or familiar franchise design. 00:00–00:06 — Begin behind the keeper at shoulder height. Track slowly toward the parapet as she places the lantern on its flat base. Wet stone reflects its light. 00:06–00:13 — She opens the lantern's metal shutter twice with her right hand. Each opening exposes the same steady flame; it is not an electrical strobe. Keep the camera on her side of the balcony. 00:13–00:20 — A single distant window answers with two warm pulses. She leaves the shutter open and rests her hands on the parapet. Hold the harbor view for three seconds. LOCK: Same face, coat, lantern handle, balcony geometry and distant window position. Only the two visible light sources change. AUDIO: Wind against masonry, shutter hinge, distant harbor water. No speech, score or foghorn. AVOID: extra signals, floating lantern, futuristic skyline, new people, changing weather, written text, logos or watermark. ``` ## C02 — A wall between rehearsals **Use:** simultaneous split-screen story **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** instruments, but keep two rooms and one shared wall. ```text Show two equal side-by-side panels throughout. Left: an adult cellist in a cream jumper rehearses in a modest room. Right: a young adult drummer in a blue shirt practices on a rubber pad in the neighboring room. These are different people and spaces. 00:00–00:06 — Locked medium views. The cellist plays a short original three-note phrase; the drummer taps an unrelated four-beat pattern. Neither looks toward the camera. 00:06–00:12 — The cellist stops and taps the shared wall gently twice. The drummer hears the two taps from the correct side, stops, then answers with the same rhythm on the wall. 00:12–00:18 — Both resume, now matching a quiet pulse. Each smiles privately. Keep the dividing line fixed and hold both frames. LOCK: Bow stays in the cellist's right hand; two drumsticks remain visible. Preserve chair locations, wall orientation and window light. AUDIO: One coherent mix, cello left and practice pad right, with muffled wall transmission. Original music only; no recognizable melody or speech. AVOID: swapping rooms, overlapping bodies, teleporting instruments, asynchronous answering taps, captions, extra performers or watermark. ``` ## C03 — The smallest opening night **Use:** contained dialogue comedy **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 4:3, 15 seconds **Adjust:** miniature scenery, not the joke's timing. ```text A miniature theater maker in a charcoal apron sits at a workbench beside one adult friend in a red cardigan. A shoebox-size stage has a closed blue curtain. The maker holds a full-size pair of binoculars. 00:00–00:05 — Locked two-shot at bench height. The friend studies the tiny stage and asks in conversational English, exactly: "Where do I sit?" 00:05–00:10 — The maker silently slides a normal chair ten centimeters closer. Keep a full two-second pause, then pass the binoculars handle-first. 00:10–00:15 — The friend raises them and says exactly: "Excellent view." The miniature curtain opens a little through a visible pull cord. End before any performance starts. LOCK: Two people, two chairs, one pair of binoculars, one stage. The stage stays miniature; do not reveal a full-size theater. AUDIO: Chair scrape, cloth curtain, unprocessed close dialogue and room tone. No applause, laugh track or score. AVOID: exaggerated expressions, shrinking people, extra lines, camera cuts during the handoff, text, brand marks or watermark. ``` ## C04 — The reflection arrives late **Use:** controlled magical realism **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 2:1, 18 seconds **Adjust:** garment color; preserve the deliberate reflection delay. ```text One adult museum guard in a navy uniform stands in a quiet gallery before a single floor-length mirror. Treat the mirror's behavior as the only impossible element in an otherwise natural scene. 00:00–00:06 — Locked three-quarter wide shot showing guard and full mirror. The guard lifts her left hand to straighten her collar. Her reflection remains still for one second, then repeats the same movement. 00:06–00:12 — She lowers her hand slowly and watches. The reflection again follows exactly one second later. Keep her face calm rather than frightened. 00:12–00:18 — She takes one small step away. The reflection raises a hand before she does; she notices and finally answers the gesture. Hold without a jump scare. LOCK: Identical face, collar, hairstyle and gallery perspective in both versions. No other reflective surface or moving artwork. AUDIO: Shoe contact and ventilation. No mirrored duplicate footsteps, dialogue, horror sting or music. AVOID: unrelated reflection actions, extra people, morphing face, camera drift, broken glass, captions or watermark. ``` ## C05 — A door left warm **Use:** wordless character introduction **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 15 seconds **Adjust:** workshop craft; preserve the courteous action. ```text Create a quiet evening short in a small bookbinding workshop. One older craftsperson in a blue linen apron is closing for the day. A younger apprentice is still sewing one book at a rear desk. 00:00–00:05 — Static wide view from the hallway. The craftsperson reaches for the main light switch and notices the apprentice's occupied hands. 00:05–00:10 — Without speaking, the craftsperson turns on the apprentice's task lamp first, then switches off the overhead lights. Show both actions and their lighting consequences in order. 00:10–00:15 — The craftsperson leaves the door slightly open. The apprentice briefly looks up, then returns to the same page. End on the warm pool of light within the darker room. LOCK: The unfinished book, needle, thread path, lamp and door hinge stay in place. Preserve natural skin and modest workshop clutter. AUDIO: Switch clicks, thread through paper, restrained footsteps and the door latch. No sentimental music or dialogue. AVOID: magically lit lamp, extra books appearing, suddenly completed binding, pitch-black faces, title cards, logos or watermark. ``` ## C06 — The red scarf cut **Use:** an editorial match cut between distinct scenes **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 16 seconds **Adjust:** destinations; retain the red fabric and movement direction. ```text Make a two-scene fictional travel short with exactly one visible editorial cut. It is a visual association, not a teleportation claim. 00:00–00:07 — In a cool city apartment, an adult woman folds a plain red scarf on a wooden table. Medium close view, natural window light. She lifts the folded scarf from left to right until it briefly fills the frame. 00:07 — Cut on that red fabric movement. 00:07–00:13 — In a warm rural guest room, the same woman lowers the same scarf onto a different table, completing the left-to-right gesture. Her coat is now off and lies visibly on a chair; the location change is intentional. 00:13–00:16 — Camera settles to reveal an open window and distant hills. She rests her hands on the table. AUDIO: Apartment traffic cuts to gentle wind and insects at the edit. Fabric sound bridges the cut; no music or narration. LOCK: Preserve face, scarf weave, fold and hand orientation across the cut. AVOID: intermediate morphing scenery, additional cuts, changing scarf color, travel logos, generated location labels or watermark. ```

Label generated scenes as reconstructions or illustrations; they are not recorded evidence of people, places or animal behavior. ## D01 — Before the first ferry **Use:** human-interest concept film **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** fictional harbor details without adding location claims. ```text An older ferry-terminal cleaner in a faded orange work jacket is finishing a bench before sunrise. One early passenger waits several steps away with a folded newspaper. 00:00–00:06 — Static wide view under a simple shelter. The cleaner wipes the last section of the wooden bench, moving moisture toward one end. 00:06–00:12 — Medium side view. The passenger waits until the cleaner lifts the cloth, then points quietly at the seat. The cleaner nods and steps back. 00:12–00:18 — The passenger sits at the dry end. The cleaner folds the same cloth and places it in a bucket. Hold the two people looking toward the water. LOCK: Same jacket, bench slats, bucket, newspaper and seating positions. Dawn light remains cool and steady. AUDIO: Cloth on wood, distant water, gulls well away from camera and a low terminal hum. No dialogue, sentimental music or ferry announcement. AVOID: staged gratitude, extra passengers, a ferry materializing, dry areas becoming wet again, documentary authenticity claims, readable signs or watermark. ``` ## D02 — Along the reed edge **Use:** observational wildlife-style concept **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 2:1, 20 seconds **Adjust:** weather, not species-specific anatomy. ```text One adult grey heron stands ankle-deep in a shallow reed-fringed pond. Observe from a distant, stationary telephoto viewpoint; this is a synthetic scene, not wildlife footage. 00:00–00:07 — The heron waits with its neck partially folded. Reeds move gently in one breeze; small ripples pass its legs. 00:07–00:14 — It takes one slow deliberate step along the bank, lifting its foot clear before placing it down. The displaced water makes one small ripple. The head stays balanced. 00:14–00:20 — It stops and turns its head slightly toward something outside the frame. Hold the patient posture. No prey capture or takeoff. AUDIO: Reed rustle, distant pond insects and soft water. Do not add a dramatic animal cry. LOCK: One bird, two legs, consistent feather pattern, body scale, water depth and reflection. AVOID: bending beak, extra joints, anthropomorphic expression, bait, approaching camera, attacking prey, repeated identical ripples, music, labels or watermark. ``` ## D03 — The neighborhood repair shelf **Use:** community process explainer **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds **Adjust:** object type; keep repair status unambiguous. ```text Illustrate a fictional community repair desk. Three shelf bays carry blank removable cards, with final labels to be added in post. One volunteer in a blue apron handles an unplugged desk fan with a visibly loose front grille. 00:00–00:06 — Wide view: place the fan in the first bay beside its detached grille screw. 00:06–00:13 — Cut to a bench where the volunteer seats the grille and tightens the existing screw with a hand screwdriver. The cable remains unplugged and visible. No electrical testing. 00:13–00:20 — Return the fan to the middle bay, not the final bay. Hold on the blank status card to show it still awaits inspection. AUDIO: Quiet community room, screw contact, shelf tap. English narration exactly: "A repair is one step. Inspection comes before an item returns to use." LOCK: Same fan, screw, cable and volunteer. Use an ordinary modest space. AVOID: spinning blades, live electrical work, invented certification, automatic completion labels, magically restored finish, text, logos or watermark. ``` ## D04 — A letter, not an archive **Use:** clearly fictional period-style reconstruction **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 4:3, 18 seconds **Adjust:** paper and desk texture, not an unverified historical identity. ```text Create a fictional analog-era domestic scene without claiming a precise place or date. An adult in a plain wool cardigan writes at a wooden desk beside an oil lamp; keep loose fabric away from the flame. 00:00–00:06 — Locked close three-quarter view. The writer finishes one line on paper angled away so no writing is legible. 00:06–00:12 — They fold the sheet in thirds, slide it into a plain envelope and press the flap closed. Show coherent hand contact and paper thickness. 00:12–00:18 — Place the envelope beside a second sealed letter, then look toward a rain-dark window outside focus. End on the pair of envelopes. AUDIO: Pen scratches, paper folds and soft rain. Newly imagined sound, not purported archival audio. No speech or score. LOCK: Same lamp, two envelopes at the end, writing hand, paper and desk grain. AVOID: famous people, invented historical dates, national insignia, fake archive stamps, readable handwriting, film damage obscuring faces, extra letters or watermark. ``` ## D05 — After the rain, at ground level **Use:** small-scale nature observation **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 15 seconds **Adjust:** leaf species after checking its shape. ```text Create one continuous macro observation of a curled fallen leaf on damp forest soil. A single small snail is already partly sheltered beneath it. No other animals. 00:00–00:05 — Camera stays fixed at soil level. One droplet hangs from the lowest leaf tip. The snail's tentacles extend slowly, with no sudden head turn. 00:05–00:10 — The droplet grows from water already on the leaf and falls onto the soil beside, not onto, the snail. Make one subtle splash scaled to the subject. 00:10–00:15 — The snail advances only a few millimeters. Focus remains on its front edge; the shell and wet leaf stay in view. AUDIO: Very quiet distant woodland ambience. No giant footsteps, amplified chewing, dramatic plop or music. LOCK: Leaf veins, shell spiral, animal size, shallow depth of field and diffuse light. AVOID: time-lapse speed, smiling snail, extra eyes, changing shell, upward water, human hands, text or watermark. ``` ## D06 — Measuring the shade **Use:** environmental fieldwork visualization **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds **Adjust:** park surface and clothing; measurements must remain fictional. ```text Two adult fieldworkers compare a shaded pavement area with a nearby sunlit area in a generic park. Show a method, never invented measured values. One worker carries a handheld temperature probe with its display facing away. 00:00–00:06 — Locked wide view includes both patches and the same tree. Worker kneels at the sunlit patch, positioning the probe consistently above the surface. 00:06–00:13 — Worker moves along the pavement to the shade boundary and repeats the same posture and probe distance. The second worker observes and writes on an unreadable clipboard. 00:13–00:20 — Medium view of the pair discussing silently; camera settles on the stable light boundary. AUDIO: Footsteps, pen and distant park ambience. No voice-over or electronic reading beep. LOCK: Same equipment, surface, measurement height and sunlight direction. AVOID: fabricated numbers, thermal overlays, guaranteed temperature reduction, changed surfaces, time-of-day jump, unsafe road positioning, text, logos or watermark. ```

# Generative AI for Beginners (Version 3) - A Course

Learn the fundamentals of building Generative AI applications with our 21-lesson comprehensive course by Microsoft Cloud Advocates.

## 🌱 Getting Started

This course has 21 lessons. Each lesson covers its own topic so start wherever you like!

Lessons are labeled either "Learn" lessons explaining a Generative AI concept or "Build" lessons that explain a concept and code examples in both **Python** and **TypeScript** when possible.

For .NET Developers checkout [Generative AI for Beginners (.NET Edition)](https://github.com/microsoft/Generative-AI-for-beginners-dotnet?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst)!

Each lesson also includes a "Keep Learning" section with additional learning tools.

## What You Need
### To run the code of this course, you can use either: 
 - [Azure OpenAI Service](https://aka.ms/genai-beginners/azure-open-ai?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) - **Lessons:** "aoai-assignment"
 - [Microsoft Foundry Models](https://ai.azure.com/catalog/models?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) - **Lessons:** "githubmodels" (GitHub Models is retiring at the end of July 2026 - use Microsoft Foundry Models instead)
 - [OpenAI API](https://aka.ms/genai-beginners/open-ai?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) - **Lessons:** "oai-assignment" 
 - [Foundry Local](https://foundrylocal.ai?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) - Run models fully offline on your own device, no cloud subscription required
   
- Basic knowledge of Python or TypeScript is helpful - \*For absolute beginners check out these [Python](https://aka.ms/genai-beginners/python?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) and [TypeScript](https://aka.ms/genai-beginners/typescript?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) courses
- A GitHub account to [fork this entire repo](https://aka.ms/genai-beginners/github?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) to your own GitHub account

We have created a **[Course Setup](./00-course-setup/README.md?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst)** lesson to help you with setting up your development environment.

Don't forget to [star (🌟) this repo](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/exploring-projects-on-github/saving-repositories-with-stars?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) to find it easier later.

## 🧠 Ready to Deploy?

If you are looking for more advanced code samples, check out our [collection of Generative AI Code Samples](https://aka.ms/genai-beg-code?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) in both **Python** and **TypeScript**.

## 🗣️ Meet Other Learners, Get Support

Join our [official Microsoft Foundry Discord server](https://aka.ms/genai-discord?WT.mc_id=academic-105485-koreyst) t

# إعداد السحابة ☁️ – GitHub Codespaces

**استخدم هذا الدليل إذا كنت لا تريد تثبيت أي شيء محليًا.**  
توفر لك Codespaces نسخة مجانية من VS Code تعمل عبر المتصفح مع جميع التبعيات مثبتة مسبقًا.

---

## 1.  لماذا Codespaces؟

| الفائدة | ماذا يعني ذلك بالنسبة لك |
|---------|----------------------|
| ✅ بدون تثبيت | يعمل على Chromebook و iPad وأجهزة مختبرات المدرسة... |
| ✅ حاوية تطوير مبنية مسبقًا | Python 3، Node.js، .NET، Java موجودة بالفعل |
| ✅ حصة مجانية | الحسابات الشخصية تحصل على **120 ساعة نواة / 60 ساعة جيجابايت شهريًا** |

> 💡 **نصيحة**  
> حافظ على صحة حصتك عن طريق **إيقاف** أو **حذف** كود سبيس غير النشط  
> (عرض ▸ لوحة الأوامر ▸ *Codespaces: Stop Codespace*).

---

## 2.  إنشاء Codespace (بنقرة واحدة)

1. **افتح نسخة من** هذا المستودع (زر **Fork** في الأعلى إلى اليمين).  
2. في نسختك، اضغط على **Code ▸ Codespaces ▸ Create codespace on main**.  
   ![Dialog showing buttons to create a codespace](../../../translated_images/ar/who-will-pay.4c0609b1c7780f44.webp)

✅ يفتح نافذة VS Code في المتصفح وتبدأ حاوية التطوير في الإنشاء.
تستغرق هذه العملية **حوالي دقيقتين** في المرة الأولى.

## 3. أضف مفتاح API الخاص بك (الطريقة الآمنة)

### الخيار أ أسرار Codespaces — موصى به

1. ⚙️ أيقونة الترس -> لوحة الأوامر -> Codespaces : إدارة سر المستخدم -> إضافة سر جديد.
2. الاسم: OPENAI_API_KEY
3. القيمة: ألصق المفتاح → إضافة السر

هذا كل شيء — سيستخدم رمزنا المفتاح تلقائيًا.

### الخيار ب ملف .env (إذا كنت بحاجة فعلًا إلى واحد)

```bash
cp .env.copy .env
code .env         # قم بملء OPENAI_API_KEY=مفتاحك_هنا
```

Ponytail

He says nothing. He writes one line. It works.

~54% less code (up to 94%) · ~20% cheaper · ~27% faster · 100% safe
Measured on real Claude Code sessions editing a real open-source repo (FastAPI + React), against the same agent with no skill. ~54% is the mean across 12 feature tasks (Haiku 4.5, n=4); it reaches 94% where an agent over-builds (a date picker) and is near zero where the code is already minimal. ponytail keeps every safety guard while a bare "write one-liners" prompt drops one. (The earlier single-shot benchmark reported 80-94% as a flat figure; against a fair agentic baseline that is the per-task ceiling, not the average.) Full writeup · reproduce it.

Español · 한국어

---

You know him. Long ponytail. Oval glasses. Has been at the company longer than the version control. You show him fifty lines; he looks at them, says nothing, and replaces them with one. Ponytail puts him inside your AI agent. ## Before / after You ask for a date picker. Your agent installs flatpickr, writes a wrapper component, adds a stylesheet, and starts a discussion about timezones. With ponytail: ```html ``` More survivors in [examples/](examples/). ## Numbers The honest measurement is a real agent doing real work: a headless Claude Code session editing [tiangolo's full-stack-fastapi-template](https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template) (a real FastAPI + React repo), scored on the `git diff` it leaves behind. Twelve feature tickets, the same agent with and without the skill, n=4, Haiku 4.5.

| vs no-skill baseline | LOC | tokens | cost | time | safe | |---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | **ponytail** | **-54%** | **-22%** | **-20%** | **-27%** | **100%** | | caveman (terse-prose control) | -20% | +7% | +3% | +2% | 100% | | "YAGNI + one-liners" prompt | -33% | -14% | -21% | -30% | 95% | ponytail is the only arm that cuts every metric, and the only one that stays fully safe while doing it. The cut is biggest where there is a real over-build trap (date picker 404 to 23 lines, color picker 287 to 23, because it reaches for a native `` instead of a component) and near zero on code that is already minimal. Full method, per-task tables, and limitations: [benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md](benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md).
Older single-shot numbers (isolated generation) Five everyday tasks, three models, three arms (no skill, [caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman), ponytail), ten runs, median reported. One prompt, one completion, counting lines of the answer:

This showed **80-94% less code**. [#126](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/issues/126) fairly pointed out that the bare-model baseline pads its answer with prose and options, so that gap is partly a conversational-baseline artifact. The agentic numbers above are the corrected, defensible version. Reproduce the single-shot run with `npx promptfoo eval -c benchmarks/promptfooconfig.yaml`.
**The rule was never "fewest tokens."** It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. The code ends up small because it is necessary, not golfed. Lower cost and latency are a side effect on the models that follow the ladder; a terse reasoning model that spends thinking tokens deliberating the rungs can go the other way (on GPT-5.5 it does). ## How it works Before writing code, the agent stops at the first rung that holds: ``` 1. Does this need to exist? → no: skip it (YAGNI) 2. Already in this codebase? → reuse it, don't rewrite 3. Stdlib does it? → use it 4. Native platform feature? → use it 5. Installed dependency? → use it 6. One line? → one line 7. Only then: the minimum that works ``` The ladder runs *after* it understands the problem, not instead of it: it reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow before picking a rung. Lazy about the solution, never about reading. Lazy, not negligent: trust-boundary validation, data-loss handling, security, and accessibility are never on the chopping block. ## Install The most effort ponytail will ever ask of you: The Claude Code and Codex plugins run two tiny Node.js lifecycle hooks, so `node` needs to be on your PATH (note for Nix/nvm users: it must be on the non-interactive shell's PATH). If it isn't, the skills still work, the always-on activation just stays quiet instead of erroring on every prompt. ### Claude Code ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` ``` /plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` (You have to send two separate prompts for the install to work) Same steps in the Claude Code Desktop app's Code tab: type the two `/plugin` commands above into the prompt box, or click the **+** button next to it, choose **Plugins** → **Add plugin** to browse your configured marketplaces, and manage marketplaces from **Customize** in the sidebar. ### Codex ```bash codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail ``` Run `codex` and open `/hooks`, review and trust its two lifecycle hooks, and start a new thread. This same install also covers the Codex desktop app: restart the app after installing and it picks up the plugin. ### GitHub Copilot CLI ```bash copilot plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail copilot plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` In an interactive Copilot CLI session, use the slash equivalents: ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert
